_doc: One object per downloaded recording, in audio/assets/manifests/<category>.json (a JSON list). Values here are placeholders: copy the shape, never the data. Every field is read from the item's own page; never guess a licence. 'attribution' is required for CC BY (paste the form the author asks for on their page, else: "<title>" by <author> (<page_url>), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)); null for CC0 / Mixkit / Pixabay. 'analysis' is what analyze.py measured; 'best_segment' the clean part in seconds.
